_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own values. config.json is gitignored.
_secretEnvVar: Name of the environment variable holding the client secret. The secret is NEVER read from this file or from the command line.
_selection: Pick exactly one. environmentIdFile wins, then groupName, then namePattern. If all are null the script targets EVERY Dataverse-backed environment in the tenant - be deliberate about that.
_throttleLimit: Environments processed concurrently. Each environment is its own service-protection bucket, so width is safe. Start at 8.
_additionalProcessNames: Extra process names to include beyond the four AI Primary Entities. IsPaiEnabled is already built in. Add names here only after confirming they exist in your org.
